saints.name: St. Cyril of Alexandria
saints.title: Bishop and Doctor of the Church
saints.shortBlurb: The patriarch who championed the title “Mother of God” and led the Council of Ephesus against Nestorius…
biography: Cyril became Patriarch of Alexandria in 412 and emerged as the foremost theologian in the controversy over the person of Christ. When Nestorius of Constantinople denied to the Virgin Mary the title Theotokos, “God-bearer,” Cyril defended it as the guardian of the truth that in Christ God and man are one person.

He presided over the Council of Ephesus in 431, which condemned Nestorius and proclaimed Mary Mother of God. A profound writer on the Incarnation, he died in 444 and was declared a Doctor of the Church in 1883.
saints.knownFor: Defending the title “Mother of God” at Ephesus.

canonization.canonized: Venerated from antiquity; Doctor of the Church (1883)
